items.title: START THE COUNTDOWN: TIME MISSION TO OPEN IN MUSIC CITY THIS YEAR
items.summary: Time Mission will open its largest location yet—a 12,000-square-foot, 28-mission venue at Cummins Station in Nashville—by the end of 2026.

items.title: Time Mission Announces New Immersive Adventure Steps from Boston's Faneuil Hall
items.summary: Time Mission plans to open an 8,600-square-foot venue at Marketplace Center, 200 State Street, in early 2027. The new venue, adjacent to Faneuil Hall Marketplace, will bring mission rooms to downtown Boston for the first time.

items.title: Time Mission announces major global expansion with 15 to 20 new locations planned for 2027
items.summary: Time Mission announced plans for its most ambitious expansion to date, with 15 to 20 new locations planned for 2027 and venues currently under construction across the United States and Europe.
